title: Learning the Kohn-Sham map with neural operators for quasi-linear scaling density functional theory
title_zh: 用神经算子学习Kohn-Sham映射实现准线性密度泛函理论
summary: 核心创新是把Kohn-Sham自洽问题表述为可学习的算子映射，减少轨道对角化依赖。摘要未披露神经算子具体架构、训练数据和守恒约束，也未给出准线性标度的定量验证。若结果成立，它将直接连接机器学习哈密顿量、电子密度预测与大尺度DFT加速，但当前不能判断其对缺陷、磁性或强关联体系的可迁移性。
abstract: arXiv:2608.23895v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kohn--Sham density functional theory (DFT) underpins electronic-structure simulations, but repeated orbital diagonalizations lead to cubic scaling, restricting quantum calculations to modest scales only. Eliminating these auxiliary orbitals while retaining Kohn--Sham accuracy is the central goal of orbital-free DFT, but both analytical and machine-learning methods have so far fallen short. Prior learning approaches either try to learn the variational kinetic-energy functionals, which are ill-conditioned, or directly predict the ground state, which extrapolate poorly to larger systems. Instead, we identify the Kohn--Sham map as the right learning target for orbital-free DFT. It maps a Kohn--Sham potential directly to the corresponding density and noninteracting kinetic energy, quantities otherwise obtained through an orbital diagonalization. Focusing on the density component in this work, a domain-invariant SE(3)-equivariant Fourier neural operator learns to predict it from the potential as input on real-space grids, enabling stable quasi-linear scaling SCFs. Trained jointly on 8,504 molecules and solids, a single model generalizes to out-of-distribution organic molecules, insulators, and metals. For the first time, the same method converges SCFs across these systems without explicitly constructing Kohn--Sham orbitals, while reproducing densities, electronic spectra, and structural observables at Kohn--Sham DFT accuracy. Linear-scaling SCFs additionally allow converging magnesium dislocation densities containing up to 82,500 valence electrons on a single GPU.

title: Stacking-induced type-II quantum spin Hall insulators with high spin Chern number in unconventional magnetism
title_zh: 堆垛诱导的高自旋陈数第二类量子自旋霍尔绝缘体
summary: 工作提出第二类量子自旋霍尔绝缘体堆垛后可保持并增强拓扑性，而不是简单相消。晶格模型给出高自旋陈数和两对相反手性、相反极化边缘态，但摘要没有提供材料候选或第一性原理验证。其直接价值在于拓扑层状结构的设计规则，和团队的磁性、非共线自旋及拓扑材料计算存在概念交叉。
abstract: arXiv:2508.05365v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: While stacking two type-I quantum spin Hall insulators typically results in a trivial insulator, the behavior of the assembly of type-II quantum spin Hall insulators remains unexplored. In this article, based on calculations of a lattice model, we demonstrate that stacking two type-II quantum spin Hall insulators does not yield a trivial insulator but instead forms a nontrivial quantum spin Hall insulator with high spin Chern number. In this phase, two pairs of topological edge states with opposite chirality and polarization coexist at the boundary. Our calculations further reveal that the quantized spin Hall conductivity of the bilayer is twice that of the monolayer. When U(1) symmetry is present, the high spin Chern number phase remains stable; when U(1) symmetry is broken, it persists over a broad parameter range. Furthermore, based on first-principles electronic structure calculations, we demonstrate that bilayer Nb₂SeTeO is a type-II quantum spin Hall insulator with a high spin Chern number in altermagnetism and unconventional compensated magnetism. Moreover, extending this strategy to multilayer stacks naturally leads to a quantum spin Hall insulator with a higher spin Chern number. Our work not only deepens the distinction between type-I and type-II quantum spin Hall insulators, but also offers a route toward realizing highly quantized spin Hall conductivity.

title: Equivariant Cellular Sheaves for Molecular Electronic Structure: Bridging Sheaf Cohomology and E(3)-Equivariant Hamiltonian Learning
title_zh: 分子电子结构的等变细胞层：连接层上同调与E(3)等变哈密顿量学习
summary: 核心创新是把局域轨道哈密顿量重写为细胞层拉普拉斯，从结构上统一电子结构和拓扑深度学习。方法强调E(3)等变性与层上同调，但目前没有披露训练策略、基组、损失函数或定量误差。该框架与机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量直接相关，可能为保持轨道耦合拓扑和几何约束提供新的表示方式。
abstract: arXiv:2608.23571v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Equivariant message-passing networks are the standard model for molecular property and interatomic-potential prediction, and recent work predicts the electronic Hamiltonian itself in an E(3)-equivariant way. Separately, topological deep learning has extended graph networks to cellular sheaves. Our central observation is structural: in a localized atomic-orbital basis, the molecular single-particle Hamiltonian, after a constant shift that makes it positive semidefinite, is the Laplacian of a cellular sheaf on a regular cell complex built from the molecule. Making the restriction maps O(3)-steerable two-center kernels from bond geometry recovers the Slater-Koster form as a special case and yields an E(3)- and permutation-equivariant operator. Three consequences follow. First, the zeroth sheaf cohomology H⁰ = ker L is a topological invariant equal to the non-bonding (zero-mode) orbitals, recovering the classical alternant non-bonding-orbital count as a lower bound. Second, the Hodge 1-Laplacian lets higher cells (rings) carry cycle and delocalization information through H¹. Third, the model strictly generalizes E(3)-equivariant message-passing networks and CW networks, and inherits the anti-oversmoothing of non-trivial sheaf diffusion. We prove equivariance, expressivity, and cohomological-correspondence results for the Equivariant Cellular Sheaf Networks, and validate them numerically: the Hamiltonian-to-sheaf embedding is exact to machine precision, the cohomology dimension reproduces non-bonding-orbital counts across eleven conjugated molecules, the sheaf Laplacian is O(3)-equivariant to machine precision, and the equivariant model attains lower error and rotation generalization on a directional electronic target. Our contribution is this sheaf-theoretic formalization and its invariants, not equivariant Hamiltonian prediction itself.

title: Bipolarized Weyl semimetals and quantum crystal valley Hall effect in two-dimensional altermagnetic materials
title_zh: 双极化外尔半金属与二维交错磁材料中的量子晶体谷霍尔效应
summary: 磁性和拓扑是凝聚态物理中的两个重要领域。磁性与拓扑的结合会产生更多新颖的物理效应，因此受到了理论和实验研究的高度关注。近年来，人们提出了交错磁性的概念，其特征是具有二重性质：实空间中的反平行自旋、零总磁矩，以及倒空间中的各向异性自旋极化。交错磁性与拓扑的结合可能导致此前未被观测到的拓扑相及其相关物理效应。在本研究中，我们利用包含交错磁性和自旋群对称性的四带晶格模型，证明了I型、II型和III型双极化外尔半金属可以存在于交错磁系统中。通过第一性原理电子结构计算，我们预测了四种理…
abstract: arXiv:2406.16603v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetism and topology are two major areas of condensed matter physics. The combination of magnetism and topology gives rise to more novel physical effects, which have attracted strongly theoretical and experimental attention. Recently, the concept of altermagnetism has been introduced, characterized by a dual nature: real-space antiparallel spins with zero total magnetic moment and reciprocal-space anisotropic spin polarization. The amalgamation of altermagnetism with topology may lead to the emergence of previously unobserved topological phases and the associated physical effects. In this study, utilizing a four-band lattice model that incorporates altermagnetism and spin group symmetry, we demonstrate that type-I, type-II, and type-III bipolarized Weyl semimetals can exist in altermagnetic systems. Through the first-principles electronic structure calculations, we predict four ideal two-dimensional type-I altermagnetic bipolarized Weyl semimetals Fe₂WTe₄ and Fe₂MoZ₄ (Z=S, Se, Te). More significantly, we introduce the quantum crystal valley Hall effect, a phenomenon achievable in three of these materials namely Fe₂WTe₄, Fe₂MoS₄, and Fe₂MoSe₄, when spin-orbit coupling is considered. Therefore, our work not only enriches the topological phases but also provides a material platform for studying novel topological phases in altermagnetism.

title: Capturing Nuclear Quantum Effects in Hydrogen Diffusion through MoS2 via Machine-Learning-Enhanced Path-Integral Simulations
title_zh: 通过机器学习增强路径积分模拟捕捉氢在MoS2中的扩散核量子效应
summary: 氢穿过层状二维（2D）材料的输运是储氢、燃料电池和同位素分离等技术的核心问题。对于这些材料中的MoS2，其层间扩散性质可调，而对其进行准确的理论描述需要考虑包括零点运动和隧穿在内的核量子效应（NQEs）。在此，我们提出一项由机器学习增强的原子尺度研究，考察层状MoS2中氢和氘的扩散；该研究基于采用r2SCAN+rVV10密度泛函理论数据训练得到的原子间势。通过结合阱温偏置元动力学与路径积分分子动力学，我们在显式纳入核量子效应的条件下，研究了跨越多种MoS2多型和扭转双层结构的…
abstract: arXiv:2606.25991v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hydrogen transport through layered two-dimensional (2D) materials is central to technologies such as hydrogen storage, fuel cells, and isotope separation. Among these materials, MoS2 exhibits tunable interlayer diffusion properties, whose accurate theoretical description requires accounting for nuclear quantum effects (NQEs), including zero-point motion and tunneling. Here, we present a machine-learning-enhanced atomistic study of hydrogen and deuterium diffusion in layered MoS2 based on interatomic potentials trained on r2SCAN+rVV10 density-functional-theory data. Combining well-tempered metadynamics with path-integral molecular dynamics, we investigate diffusion across multiple MoS2 polytypes and twisted bilayer structures while explicitly incorporating NQEs. Our simulations show that NQEs substantially lower free-energy barriers for hydrogen diffusion at 300 K, significantly increasing the hydrogen self-diffusion coefficient compared to classical nuclei simulations. We further identify a pronounced kinetic isotope effect, with a 35 meV difference between hydrogen and deuterium quantum free-energy barriers. In twisted bilayer MoS2, hydrogen transport exhibits strong spatial variations governed by the local stacking environments within the moiré superlattices. These results highlight the critical role of NQEs in hydrogen transport through layered materials and provide atomistic insight intoisotope-selective diffusion in structurally complex 2D systems.

title: Moiré Mott correlated mosaics in twisted bilayer 1T-TaS₂
title_zh: 扭转双层1T-TaS₂中的莫尔Mott关联马赛克
summary: 范德华材料的可调控性和扭转工程能够产生单个单层中不存在的电子态。其中，单层1T-TaS₂是一个众所周知的Mott绝缘体系，其大卫之星电荷密度波重构形成了由局域磁矩构成的涌现三角晶格。有趣的是，在其块体形式中，绝缘隙并非由关联驱动，而是源于层间耦合。本文利用绝缘隙对堆垛方式的依赖性表明，在扭转1T-TaS₂双层中，多体能隙与单粒子能隙之间随空间变化的竞争会产生Mott-平庸马赛克超晶格，其中包括具有局域磁矩的区域和非磁性绝缘区域。我们进一步证明，该马赛克关联态可通过层间偏压进行…
abstract: arXiv:2604.02001v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The tunability and twist engineering of van der Waals materials enable the emergence of electronic states not present in individual monolayers. Among them, monolayer 1T-TaS₂ is a well-known Mott insulating system, whose star-of-David charge density wave reconstruction realizes an emergent triangular lattice of local magnetic moments. Interestingly, in its bulk form, the insulating gap is not correlation-driven, but stems from interlayer coupling. Here, we exploit the stacking-dependent nature of the insulating gap to show that in twisted 1T-TaS₂ bilayers, the spatially dependent competition between many-body and single-particle gaps creates Mott-trivial mosaic superlattices, featuring regions with local magnetic moments and non-magnetic insulating regions. We further demonstrate the tunability of the mosaic correlated state with an interlayer bias, giving rise to controllable charge transfer and quenching of correlations. Our results establish twisted 1T-TaS₂ as a flexible platform to engineer mixed spatially modulated correlated insulating phases, arising from the moiré profile.

title: Ultrafast Formation and Annihilation of Strongly Bound, Anisotropic Excitons
title_zh: 强束缚各向异性激子的超快形成与湮灭
summary: 具有长程磁有序的范德华层状材料有望实现新型光电子和自旋电子应用。其中，CrSBr是一种空气稳定的直接带隙半导体，具有层间反铁磁有序、高度各向异性的电子结构以及强束缚激子。尤其是，已有研究表明CrSBr中的激子继承了该材料的准一维特性，并且还会与底层自旋有序耦合。然而，尽管激子形成、解离及其与自由载流子的相互作用机制对于自旋电子和光电子应用至关重要，但这些机制在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本文采用时间和角度分辨光电子能谱，绘制了CrSBr中的电子结构和激发态动力学。我们直接分辨出异…
abstract: arXiv:2603.26294v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Van der Waals (vdW) layered materials with long-range magnetic order have the potential to enable novel optoelectronic and spintronic applications. Among these, CrSBr is an air-stable, direct band gap semiconductor that hosts interlayer antiferromagnetic order, a highly anisotropic electronic structure, and strongly bound excitons. In particular, excitons in CrSBr have been shown to inherit the quasi-one-dimensional nature of the material and also couple to the underlying spinorder. However, mechanisms of exciton formation, dissociation, and interaction with free carriers remain largely unexplored, despite being crucial for spintronic and optoelectronic applications. Here, we employ time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to map the electronic structure and excited state dynamics in CrSBr. We directly resolve an exceptionally large exciton binding energy (~800 meV) and a highly anisotropic momentum space distribution of the exciton, revealing its quasi-1D real-space character. We observe an excitation-density-dependent interconversion between bound excitons and quasi-free carriers on sub- to few-picosecond timescales, indicating that many-body effects govern the excited-state dynamics and optical properties during the initial stages of relaxation. Our work highlights the strongly bound, anisotropic character of excitons in CrSBr, as well as the microscopic interactions steering relaxation pathways after photoexcitation in elevated density regimes relevant for future device applications.

title: Structure-Agnostic Prediction of the Electronic Density of States with a Chemical Language Model
title_zh: 利用化学语言模型进行与结构无关的电子态密度预测
summary: 电子态密度（DOS）通常根据弛豫后的晶体结构计算，而对于尚未合成或尚未编录的化合物，这种结构是无法获得的。在此，我们提出 DOSSIER（Density of States from Stoichiometry with Encoder Representations，基于编码器表示从化学计量比预测态密度），这是一种将元素组成直接映射为电子态密度谱的化学语言模型。该编码器通过从一种通用机器学习原子间势进行跨模态知识蒸馏进行预训练；当训练样本仅为 1000 个时，这种迁移可使误…
abstract: arXiv:2608.24513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electronic density of states (DOS) is conventionally computed from a relaxed crystal structure, which is unavailable for compounds that have been neither synthesized nor cataloged. Here we introduce DOSSIER (Density of States from Stoichiometry with Encoder Representations), a chemical language model that maps elemental composition directly to this spectrum. The encoder is pretrained by cross-modal knowledge distillation from a universal machine-learning interatomic potential; the transfer lowers the error by 11% when only 1,000 training examples are available. On the Mat2Spec benchmark, DOSSIER reaches a mean absolute error of 3.76 states eV⁻¹ against 3.64 for the best structure-aware model; on an extended Materials Project dataset, the predicted spectra yield band gaps and d-band descriptors with useful accuracy. Screening 11,977 binary and 13,251 five-component high-entropy alloy compositions for a d-projected DOS resembling that of NiPt₃ places known oxygen reduction electrocatalysts near the top of the ranking.

title: Intertwined spin-charge stripe order and polar lattice distortion in La₃Ni₂O₇
title_zh: La₃Ni₂O₇ 中交织的自旋—电荷条纹序与极性晶格畸变
summary: La₃Ni₂O₇ 的低温密度波态具有显著的自旋密度波（SDW）序，而近期实验还发现了电荷重新分布以及伴随的晶格对称性降低。然而，自旋、电荷和晶格之间的微观关系仍不清楚。我们利用第一性原理计算研究了 La₃Ni₂O₇ 电子结构和静态自旋磁化率随压力的演化，以及代表性磁构型的能量学和晶格响应。我们将 SDW 不稳定性追溯到强费米面嵌套，并发现高压下的自旋响应紧密跟随 Tₘₐₜᵣₘ C，这表明可能存在自旋涨落介导的配对。在所考察的候选磁态中，自旋—电荷条纹态在能量上占优且具有动态稳…
abstract: arXiv:2608.23823v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The low-temperature density-wave state of La₃Ni₂O₇ hosts pronounced spin-density-wave (SDW) order, while recent experiments further reveal charge redistribution and a concomitant lattice-symmetry lowering. However, the microscopic relationship among spin, charge, and lattice remains unclear. Using first-principles calculations, we investigate the pressure evolution of the electronic structure and static spin susceptibility of La₃Ni₂O₇, together with the energetics and lattice response of representative magnetic configurations. We trace the SDW instability to strong Fermi-surface nesting and find that the high-pressure spin response closely tracks Tₘₐₜₕᵣₘ C, suggesting spin-fluctuation-mediated pairing. Among the candidate magnetic states considered, the spin-charge-stripe states emerge as energetically favored and dynamically stable, developing pronounced disproportionation of both the local Ni moments and the Ni--O bond lengths. Remarkably, the lowest-energy a-stripe state spontaneously relaxes into the experimentally proposed polar Am2m structure through a polar distortion along the b axis. These results establish a unified picture in which spin, charge, and lattice responses are strongly intertwined in the low-pressure density-wave state, while spin fluctuations remain a plausible ingredient of superconductivity under pressure.

title: Can Strain or Anion Interchange Make an Unstable Structure Stable? Energetics, Lattice Dynamics and Strain-Tunable Band Gaps of Lithium Chalcohalide Antiperovskites (Li₃BA) and their Anion Interchange Variants (Li₃AB)
title_zh: 应变或阴离子互换能否使不稳定结构稳定？锂硫属卤化物反钙钛矿 Li₃BA 及其阴离子互换变体 Li₃AB 的能量学、晶格动力学与应变可调带隙
summary: 锂硫属卤化物反钙钛矿是一类很有前景的无毒铅卤钙钛矿替代材料，并可能用作锂离子电池的固态电解质。我们通过计算研究了一种相对未被探索的阴离子互换机制：由母体立方反钙钛矿 Li₃BA（A = O、S、Se、Te、Po；B = F、Cl、Br、I）得到立方 Li₃AB 衍生物。计算得到的相对能量景观为阴离子位点选择性及其对结构稳定性的作用提供了有用指导。能量稳定性结果表明，八面体内部较小的阴离子能够稳定这些结构。晶格动力学计算证实，Li₃FA（A = Te、Po）和 Li₃OB（B…
abstract: arXiv:2608.23815v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lithium chalcohalide antiperovskites are a promising, non-toxic alternative to lead halide perovskites, with potential as solid electrolytes for Li-ion batteries. we computationally investigate a relatively unexplored anion-interchange mechanism by which cubic Li₃AB derivatives are obtained from the parent cubic antiperovskite Li₃BA (A = O, S, Se, Te, Po; B = F, Cl, Br, I). The calculated relative energy landscape provides a useful guide for anion-site selectivity and its role in structural stability. The energetic stability results reveal that the smaller anion inside the octahedron stabilizes the structures. The lattice-dynamic calculations confirm that Li₃FA (A = Te, Po) and Li₃OB (B = Cl, Br, I), which are the most energetically stable compounds, are dynamically stable cubic phases without imaginary phonon modes. However, Li₃FS and Li₃FSe, while energetically stable, are dynamically unstable at equilibrium and become dynamically stable under triaxial compressive strain. In addition, we report the electronic structure and density of states (DOS) of all compounds, which show a substantial change in band gap upon anion interchange. The strain engineering of the lithium chalcohalide family illustrates how a few percent of the strain can tune the electronic band gap within the electrochemical stability window for solid battery applications. This study unveils essential characteristics of the anion site-interchange mechanism and provides a foundation for the understanding and design of lithium chalcohalide antiperovskites.

title: Josephson effect in bipolar magnetic semiconductors
title_zh: 双极磁性半导体中的约瑟夫森效应
summary: 我们理论研究了包含双极磁性半导体(BMS)的一维约瑟夫森结中的平衡电流。我们表明，自旋分辨能带的内禀交换分裂使得可通过栅极可调的BMS化学势调制，对0-π转变进行纯电学控制，从而无需外加磁场。这为实现电学可调的π结行为提供了一条可行途径，并凸显了基于BMS的约瑟夫森器件在相位可控超导电子学中的潜力。此外，在存在Rashba自旋轨道耦合时，我们发现了一种反常约瑟夫森效应，其特征是在零相位差下存在有限的平衡超电流。这一行为源于与BMS自旋极化电子结构相关的时间反演对称性的内禀破缺…
abstract: arXiv:2608.24322v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate equilibrium currents in a one-dimensional Josephson junction incorporating a bipolar magnetic semiconductor (BMS). We show that the intrinsic exchange splitting of the spin-resolved bands enables purely electrical control of the 0--π transition through gate-tunable modulation of the BMS chemical potential, eliminating the need for an external magnetic field. This provides a viable route toward electrically tunable π-junction behavior and highlights the potential of BMS-based Josephson devices for phase-controllable superconducting electronics. Furthermore, in the presence of Rashba spin--orbit coupling, we find an anomalous Josephson effect characterized by a finite equilibrium supercurrent at zero phase difference. This behavior originates from the intrinsic breaking of time-reversal symmetry associated with the spin-polarized electronic structure of the BMS. Interestingly, despite the simultaneous breaking of time-reversal and inversion symmetries---conditions often associated with nonreciprocal superconducting transport---we do not observe a Josephson diode effect. Our results therefore highlight an important distinction between anomalous Josephson transport and superconducting nonreciprocity: the former does not necessarily imply a finite critical-current asymmetry between opposite current directions.

title: Dynamical Consequences of Nontrivial Topology of Molecular Conical Intersections
title_zh: 分子圆锥交叉非平凡拓扑的动力学后果
summary: 避免交叉和圆锥交叉（CI）的电子结构拓扑不同，后者的电子波函数中存在几何相位是其特征。利用线性Jahn-Teller模型，我们表明，通过在哈密顿量中加入一个泡利σ_y项，可以从圆锥交叉构造避免交叉，同时保留圆锥交叉的非平凡拓扑。类似于固体系统，我们将一个半整数拓扑不变量推导为Berry曲率在CI核分支空间上的积分。我们通过进行最少跃迁表面跳跃模拟，研究电子拓扑对化学动力学的影响，发现本征势能面相同但拓扑不同的体系具有不同的跃迁速率。我们的工作将拓扑对分子激发态动力学的影响扩展…
abstract: arXiv:2608.24864v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The topology of the electronic structure for an avoided crossing and a conical intersection (CI) is different and is characterized by the presence of the geometric phase in the electronic wavefunction in the latter. Using the linear Jahn-Teller model, we show that an avoided crossing can be created from the conical intersection while preserving the nontrivial topology of the latter by adding a Pauli σ_y term to the Hamiltonian. Analogously to solid state systems, we derive a half-integer topological invariant as the integral of the Berry curvature over the CI nuclear branching space. We investigate the influence of electronic topology on chemical dynamics by conducting fewest-switches surface hopping simulations and find distinct hopping rates on identical eigensurfaces but with different topologies. Our work extends the influence of topology on molecular excited state dynamics beyond the Berry phase that can be practically realized through electron-nuclear and spin-orbit coupling.

title: Exciton fine structure in nanocrystals: effect of cuboidal and spheroidal shapes
title_zh: 纳米晶中激子精细结构：长方体与扁球体形状的影响
summary: 我们提出了具有扁球体和长方体形状的纳米晶中带边激子精细结构理论。我们以非微扰方式考虑了晶格的立方对称性、纳米晶的立方形状以及纳米晶单轴各向异性对空穴能态和电子-空穴交换相互作用的影响。对称性分析给出了激子精细结构的有效哈密顿量，其中由一个空穴能量劈裂常数和五个独立的交换相互作用常数参数化。数值计算表明，在具有单轴各向异性的闪锌矿纳米晶中，空穴基态劈裂的符号取决于材料参数，以及各向异性轴相对于晶轴的取向。除源于布洛赫函数对称性且通常可忽略的、传统体材料立方对称交换相互作用贡献外…
abstract: arXiv:2608.24663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the theory of the band-edge exciton fine structure in nanocrystals (NCs) with spheroidal and cuboidal shapes. The effects of the cubic symmetry of the crystal lattice, the cubic shape of the NC, and NC uniaxial anisotropy on the hole energy states and electron-hole exchange interactions are considered non-perturbatively. Symmetry analysis yields an effective Hamiltonian for the exciton fine structure, parameterized by one constant for hole energy splitting and five independent constants for exchange interaction. Numerical calculations reveal that in uniaxially anisotropic zinc-blende NCs, the sign of the hole ground state splitting depends on the material parameters and on the orientation of the anisotropy axis relative to the crystallographic axes. Beyond the conventional bulk cubically-symmetric contribution to the exchange interaction, which originates from Bloch-function symmetry and is typically negligible, in nanocrystals, we identify the contribution arising from the cubic symmetry of the envelope wavefunction. This cubically symmetric envelope-induced short-range exchange is non-negligible in cuboidal NCs and induces a pronounced splitting of the dark exciton states. We further analyze the influence of uniaxial anisotropy of the exchange constants on both the exciton fine structure and the oscillator strength. Special attention is paid to NCs, where the anisotropy of the exchange constants is comparable to a relatively small hole energy anisotropic splitting.

title: Quantum Vibronic Dynamics Shape Catalytically Relevant Au-Ligand Interfaces in Atomically Precise Gold Nanoclusters
title_zh: 量子振电动力学塑造具有催化相关性的原子级精确金纳米团簇金-配体界面
summary: 原子级精确金纳米团簇由于其电子结构源自强金属-配体相互作用，因此在光催化和能量转换中具有广泛用途。然而，这些相互作用大多是在静态框架下讨论的，光激发下金-配体界面的动态重组仍不清楚。我们采用超快瞬态光栅光谱、二维电子光谱、从头算计算和层级运动方程模拟，研究了棒状[Au25(PPh3)10(SC2H5)5Cl2]2+。多维光谱分辨出多条电子弛豫路径，以及从局域金-配体畸变到集体骨架振动的一系列相干结构运动。小波分析表明，高频金-配体振动在激发后立即出现，而低频集体模式则经由态间…
abstract: arXiv:2608.24402v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomically precise gold nanoclusters are versatile for photocatalysis and energy conversion because their electronic structure stems from strong metal-ligand interactions. However, these interactions are mostly discussed statically, leaving dynamic reorganization of Au-ligand interfaces under photoexcitation unclear. We investigate rod-shaped [Au25(PPh3)10(SC2H5)5Cl2]2+ using ultrafast transient-grating spectroscopy, two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy, ab initio calculations, and hierarchical equations-of-motion simulations. The multidimensional spectra resolve multiple electronic relaxation pathways and a hierarchy of coherent structural motions, from localized Au-ligand distortions to collective framework vibrations. Wavelet analysis reveals that high-frequency Au-ligand vibrations emerge immediately after excitation, whereas low-frequency collective modes appear later through interstate vibronic coupling, indicating sequential redistribution of structural coherence. Simulations reproduce the nonlinear response and identify the microscopic vibronic couplings responsible. The results show that photoexcitation drives continuous ultrafast reorganization of the Au-ligand bonding network, transiently reshaping interfacial electronic structure before thermalization. This work establishes dynamic Au-ligand interfaces as the microscopic link between excited-state energy flow and photochemical function in atomically precise nanoclusters.

summary: arXiv:2608.24386v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tensor-valued prediction is fundamental to geometric deep learning, yet uncertainty quantification (UQ) for such outputs remains an open challenge. Whil…
abstract: arXiv:2608.24386v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tensor-valued prediction is fundamental to geometric deep learning, yet uncertainty quantification (UQ) for such outputs remains an open challenge. While E(3)-equivariant neural networks excel at point estimates, they lack rigorous confidence measures. We focus on symmetric rank-2 tensor prediction, where the target has six Kelvin--Mandel coordinates and full uncertainty is represented by a 6×6 covariance matrix. We introduce a framework for E(3)-equivariant UQ, modeling the full predictive distribution where both mean and covariance preserve rotational symmetry. Our approach decomposes the covariance into irreducible representations Sym²⁽h̊o_c) o̧ng 2×(l=0) øplus 2×(l=2) øplus 1×(l=4). By mapping from the flat Lie algebra mathfraksym(6) to the curved SPD manifold via matrix exponentiation, we strictly ensure positive-definite covariances while maintaining exact equivariance. Furthermore, we formulate a Log-Euclidean Equivariant Scoring Objective (LE-ESO)---a robust surrogate loss based on the Multivariate Laplace distribution---providing robustness to heavy-tailed errors and stable optimization. Validation on ModelNet40 inertia tensors and Materials Project dielectric tensors demonstrates that our method achieves competitive performance and provides physically consistent, symmetry-preserving uncertainty estimates with useful risk and OOD sensitivity.

title: Imaging atomic scale stochasticity: noise in the nearly commensurate charge density wave of 1T-TaS₂ for leaky-integrator-and-fire neuromorphic emulator
title_zh: 成像原子尺度随机性：用于泄漏积分发放神经形态模拟器的1T-TaS₂近公度电荷密度波噪声
summary: 低维材料是模拟类神经元放电行为的有前景材料，而理解这种行为的原子尺度起源有助于将其集成到神经形态硬件中。我们利用扫描隧道显微镜这一能够高度局域探测电荷密度波相关性的工具，研究了室温下1T-TaS₂中的原子尺度电荷密度波噪声。我们对隧道结噪声进行了统计分析，并引入一个介观模型来解释时间上相关的电流突发；在该模型中，电荷密度波非公度畴壁的分形结构与重组过程彼此关联。这种噪声模拟了泄漏积分发放神经元的动力学。我们的结果表明，隧道结中的原子尺度电流突发可以充当脉冲神经模拟器中的有效非…
abstract: arXiv:2608.24693v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Low-dimensional materials are promising materials for emulating neuron-like firing were understanding of the atomic-scale origin of this behavior can benefit integration into neurormophic hardware. Using scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) as a highly local probe of correlations in the charge density wave (CDW), we study atomic-scale CDW noise in 1T-TaS₂ at room temperature. We statistically analyze the tunnel-junction noise and, to explain the temporally correlated current bursts, introduce a mesoscopic model in which the fractal structure and reorganization of CDW discommensurations are related. This noise mimics leaky-integrate-and-fire neuron dynamics. Our results show that atomic-scale current bursts in the tunnel junction can act as effective nonlinear elements in spiking neural emulators, enabling bioinspired processing through rich CDW dynamics at room temperature and supporting the miniaturization of spiking devices.
